resources.string: Your phone and lock are in different time zones. Passcode validity times follow the lock’s time zone (%1$s).
Lock time or time zone could not be verified. Keep the lock nearby and awake, then retry. Initialization is incomplete. Some locks only support whole-hour time zones.
